<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Implements a SHA-256 signer for cryptographic operations.

Description: The `Signer256` class is created to handle cryptographic signing using the SHA-256 hashing algorithm. It is instantiated by the `serializer` service and used by various callers for generating secure signatures. The class ensures that all generated signatures are based on the SHA-256 digest method.

Attributes:
    default_digest_method (hashlib.sha256): The default hashing algorithm used for signing operations. This attribute is set during initialization and is immutable.
</DOCSTRING>
